```{r}
#| label: setup
#| include: false
library(plotly)
library(dplyr)
library(DT)
library(jsonlite)
library(stringi)
library(sf)
library(geofi)

title_font <- list(family = "Outfit, sans-serif", size = 13, color = "#1a1a1a")

fi_dark <- "#101622"

data <- readRDS("data/fi-municipalities-population.rds")
data$Municipality <- as.character(data$Municipality)

# FI locale alphabetical order
munis <- stri_sort(unique(data$Municipality), locale = "fi_FI")
groups <- c("All", munis)

# Fi.wikipedia articles
wiki_urls <- vapply(groups, function(g) {
  if (identical(g, "All")) return("")
  paste0("https://fi.wikipedia.org/wiki/", utils::URLencode(gsub(" ", "_", g), reserved = FALSE))
}, character(1), USE.NAMES = FALSE)

pop_by_group <- lapply(groups, function(g) {
  d <- if (g == "All") {
    data |> group_by(Year) |> summarise(Count = sum(Count), .groups = "drop")
  } else {
    data |> filter(Municipality == g) |> select(Year, Count)
  }
  d |> arrange(Year)
})

# All municipalities share one year axis. The filter script keeps a single copy of it
# (window.popYears) instead of one per municipality, so check that assumption here.
pop_years <- pop_by_group[[1]]$Year
same_years <- vapply(pop_by_group, function(d) {
  length(d$Year) == length(pop_years) && all(d$Year == pop_years)
}, logical(1))
if (!all(same_years)) {
  stop("Municipalities do not all have the same years; population-filter.js assumes one shared year axis.")
}

# Pre-compute the per-municipality line chart data (the year axis and tooltips are added in the browser)
line_group_data <- lapply(seq_along(groups), function(i) {
  d <- pop_by_group[[i]]
  pad <- (max(d$Count) - min(d$Count)) * 0.1
  if (pad == 0) pad <- max(d$Count) * 0.05

  g <- groups[i]
  title_text <- if (identical(g, "All")) {
    "<b>Population Development</b> <span style='color:#666666;font-weight:400;'>(1990 \u2013 2025)</span>"
  } else {
    paste0("<b>", g, " Population Development</b> <span style='color:#666666;font-weight:400;'>(1990 \u2013 2025)</span>")
  }

  list(
    y = I(d$Count),
    yrange = I(c(min(d$Count) - pad, max(d$Count) + pad)),
    title = title_text,
    whole_number = max(d$Count) < 100000
  )
})

# Pre-compute the first-year -> last-year change (absolute + %)
first_year <- min(data$Year)
last_year <- max(data$Year)

change_group_data <- lapply(pop_by_group, function(d) {
  first <- d$Count[1]
  last <- d$Count[nrow(d)]
  diff <- last - first
  pct <- if (first != 0) (diff / first) * 100 else 0
  list(diff = diff, pct = pct, latest = last)
})

# Data only. The behaviour lives in population-filter.js, which is hand-edited and not generated.
data_js <- paste0(
  "window.popYears = ", as.character(jsonlite::toJSON(pop_years)), ";\n",
  "window.popData = ", as.character(jsonlite::toJSON(line_group_data, auto_unbox = TRUE)), ";\n",
  "window.popChangeData = ", as.character(jsonlite::toJSON(change_group_data, auto_unbox = TRUE)), ";\n",
  "window.popGroups = ", as.character(jsonlite::toJSON(groups)), ";\n",
  "window.popWikiUrls = ", as.character(jsonlite::toJSON(wiki_urls)), ";\n"
)
writeLines(data_js, "population-data.js")
```

```{r}
#| label: map-prep
#| include: false
#| warning: false
#| message: false

# Municipality boundaries from Statistics Finland (via the geofi package).
muni_sf <- geofi::get_municipalities(year = 2025, scale = 4500) |>
  sf::st_simplify(dTolerance = 500, preserveTopology = TRUE) |>
  sf::st_cast("MULTIPOLYGON")

bbox       <- sf::st_bbox(muni_sf)
map_width  <- 160
map_scale  <- unname(map_width / (bbox["xmax"] - bbox["xmin"]))
map_height <- unname((bbox["ymax"] - bbox["ymin"]) * map_scale)

# Convert one (multi)polygon geometry into an SVG <path> "d" string.
geom_to_path <- function(geom) {
  coords <- sf::st_coordinates(sf::st_sfc(geom, crs = sf::st_crs(muni_sf)))
  parts <- split(as.data.frame(coords), coords[, "L2"])
  paste(vapply(parts, function(part) {
    rings <- split(part, part$L1)
    paste(vapply(rings, function(ring) {
      x <- (ring$X - bbox["xmin"]) * map_scale
      y <- map_height - (ring$Y - bbox["ymin"]) * map_scale
      paste0("M", paste(sprintf("%.1f,%.1f", x, y), collapse = "L"), "Z")
    }, character(1)), collapse = " ")
  }, character(1)), collapse = " ")
}

muni_sf$svg_d <- vapply(sf::st_geometry(muni_sf), geom_to_path, character(1))
muni_sf$name_fi[muni_sf$name_fi == "Maarianhamina - Mariehamn"] <- "Maarianhamina"

# Match map geometries to the municipality names used elsewhere in the
# dashboard (the `munis` vector from the setup chunk).
name_lookup   <- setNames(muni_sf$svg_d, muni_sf$name_fi)
missing_munis <- setdiff(munis, names(name_lookup))
if (length(missing_munis) > 0) {
  message("Map: no matching geometry for: ", paste(missing_munis, collapse = ", "))
}

# Same fi.wikipedia.org URL scheme used for the sidebar Wikipedia link
muni_wiki_url <- function(name) {
  paste0("https://fi.wikipedia.org/wiki/", utils::URLencode(gsub(" ", "_", name), reserved = FALSE))
}

escaped_names <- gsub('"', '&quot;', names(name_lookup), fixed = TRUE)
map_wiki_urls <- vapply(names(name_lookup), muni_wiki_url, character(1), USE.NAMES = FALSE)

map_paths_html <- paste0(
  '<a class="fi-map-link" data-name="', escaped_names,
  '" href="', map_wiki_urls,
  '" target="_blank" rel="noopener" aria-label="', escaped_names, ' on Wikipedia">',
  '<path class="fi-map-muni" data-name="', escaped_names, '" d="', name_lookup, '"></path>',
  '</a>',
  collapse = "\n"
)

map_svg_html <- paste0(
  '<div class="fi-map-wrap">',
  '<svg id="fi-map" viewBox="0 0 ', round(map_width, 1), ' ', round(map_height, 1),
  '" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg">',
  map_paths_html,
  '</svg>',
  '</div>'
)
```

## {.sidebar width="200px"}

```{r}
#| label: municipality-filter
#| output: asis
options_html <- paste0(
  '<li class="fi-muni-option', ifelse(seq_along(groups) == 1, ' active', ''),
  '" role="option" data-index="', seq_along(groups) - 1, '">', groups, '</li>',
  collapse = "\n"
)

# Initial (group 1 = "All") latest population
init_latest_str <- formatC(round(change_group_data[[1]]$latest), big.mark = " ", format = "d")

# Initial (group 1 = "All") change stats
init_change <- change_group_data[[1]]
init_positive <- init_change$diff >= 0
init_abs_str <- paste0(ifelse(init_positive, "+ ", "- "),
                        formatC(abs(round(init_change$diff)), big.mark = " ", format = "d"))
init_pct_str <- paste0(ifelse(init_positive, "+ ", "- "),
                        sprintf("%.1f", abs(init_change$pct)), "%")
init_class <- ifelse(init_positive, "fi-stat-positive", "fi-stat-negative")

# Initial (group 1 = "All")
init_wiki_url <- wiki_urls[1]
init_wiki_display <- if (nzchar(init_wiki_url)) "block" else "none"

cat(paste0(
  '<div class="fi-filter">',
  '<label class="fi-filter-label">Municipality</label>',
  '<div class="fi-muni-filter" id="municipality-filter" tabindex="0" role="button" aria-haspopup="listbox" aria-expanded="false">',
  '<span class="fi-muni-filter-value">', groups[1], '</span>',
  '<svg viewBox="0 0 10 6" class="fi-muni-filter-caret"><path d="M1 1l4 4 4-4" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="1.5" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round"/></svg>',
  '<div class="fi-muni-filter-menu">',
  '<div class="fi-muni-filter-search-wrap">',
  '<input type="text" class="fi-muni-filter-search" placeholder="Search\u2026" autocomplete="off" aria-label="Search">',
  '</div>',
  '<ul class="fi-muni-filter-list" role="listbox">',
  options_html,
  '<li class="fi-muni-no-results">No matches</li>',
  '</ul>',
  '</div>',
  '</div>',
  '</div>',
  '<div class="fi-stats">',
  '<label class="fi-stats-label">Population ', last_year, '</label>',
  '<div class="fi-stats-row">',
  '<span class="fi-stat-value" id="population-latest">', init_latest_str, '</span>',
  '</div>',
  '</div>',
  '<div class="fi-stats">',
  '<label class="fi-stats-label">Change from ', first_year, ' to ', last_year, '</label>',
  '<div class="fi-stats-row">',
  '<span class="fi-stat-value ', init_class, '" id="population-change-abs">', init_abs_str, '</span>',
  '<span class="fi-stat-value fi-stat-pct ', init_class, '" id="population-change-pct">', init_pct_str, '</span>',
  '</div>',
  '</div>',
  map_svg_html,
  '<div class="fi-stats" id="population-wiki" style="display:', init_wiki_display, ';">',
  '<label class="fi-stats-label">Wikipedia</label>',
  '<a href="', init_wiki_url, '" id="population-wiki-link" class="fi-wiki-link" target="_blank" rel="noopener">',
  '<span class="fi-wiki-link-text">', groups[1], '</span>',
  '<span class="fi-wiki-link-icon">\u2197</span>',
  '</a>',
  '</div>',
  '<script src="population-data.js" defer></script>',
  '<script src="population-filter.js" defer></script>'
))
```

## Column

### Row {height="480px"}

```{r}
#| label: population-line
initial <- pop_by_group[[1]]
initial_hover <- paste0("<b>", initial$Year, "</b><br>Population: <b>",
                         formatC(round(initial$Count), big.mark = " ", format = "d"), "</b>")
initial_yrange <- unlist(line_group_data[[1]]$yrange)
initial_whole <- isTRUE(line_group_data[[1]]$whole_number)

plot_ly(elementId = "population-line") |>
  add_trace(
    data = initial,
    x = ~Year,
    y = ~Count,
    type = "scatter",
    mode = "lines",
    line = list(color = fi_dark, width = 3, shape = "spline"),
    fill = "tozeroy",
    fillcolor = "rgba(255, 204, 1, 0.6)",
    hovertext = initial_hover,
    hoverinfo = "text"
  ) |>
  layout(
    title = list(
      text = line_group_data[[1]]$title,
      font = title_font,
      x = 0
    ),
    margin = list(t = 60, pad = 8),
    separators = ". ",
    showlegend = FALSE,
    dragmode = FALSE,
    hovermode = "closest",
    hoverlabel = list(
      bgcolor = fi_dark,
      bordercolor = fi_dark,
      font = list(color = "#ffffff", family = "Inter, sans-serif", size = 13)
    ),
    xaxis = list(title = list(text = "Year",
                              font = list(family = "Inter, sans-serif", size = 12, color = "#555555")),
                 showgrid = FALSE, showline = FALSE, zeroline = FALSE,
                 dtick = 5,
                 tickfont = list(family = "Inter, sans-serif", size = 12),
                 fixedrange = TRUE),
    yaxis = list(title = "", showgrid = TRUE, gridcolor = "#eeeeee", showline = FALSE,
                 zeroline = FALSE, tickfont = list(family = "Inter, sans-serif", size = 13),
                 range = initial_yrange,
                 tickformat = if (initial_whole) ",d" else "",
                 exponentformat = if (initial_whole) "none" else "B",
                 fixedrange = TRUE),
    paper_bgcolor = "white",
    plot_bgcolor = "white"
  ) |>
  config(displayModeBar = FALSE)
```
